ARCH-001.title: NEXUS Provider-Neutral Control API Pattern
ARCH-001.content: All control endpoints follow standard REST with bearer authentication, OpenAPI schemas, and strict async/sync timeouts.

ARCH-002.title: Zero-Downtime Local Process Deployment Lifecycle
ARCH-002.content: Artifact preflight -> port availability check -> background process spawn -> HTTP health probe polling -> atomic routing update -> rollback on failure.

ARCH-003.title: Strict $0.00 FinOps Non-Billable Governance Invariant
ARCH-003.content: Never activate paid cloud services or billable model APIs automatically. All automated scanners, tests, and workers must run local-first.

ARCH-004.title: Zero-Leakage Secret Interception and 0600 Quarantine
ARCH-004.content: Compromised credentials trigger in-place regex redaction and isolation of offending files to data/secops/quarantine/ with POSIX 0600 mode.

ARCH-005.title: Sub-Second Operational Self-Healing & Port Collision Resolution
ARCH-005.content: On watchdog port collision or deadlock detection, isolate rogue PID, safely reassign ephemeral port, verify health endpoint, and update routing.
